author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review_findings: Pod car with full-circle corner wheels, siren bump and two signal arcs; weakest of the batch -- dome reads slightly triangular because it narrows into the beacon.
Three earlier attempts rejected: long beacon stub read as a coat hanger; tall narrow dome read as a bell; one failed MIC at 7.82 (signal arc to dome).
omissions: Inner signal arcs dropped (no 8-unit room between arc pairs).
Round window and its sill line dropped (dome interior cannot hold them with 8-unit clearance).
